Is there anything else a beginner needs to get started?
Beyond the protein powder itself, you really only need one essential tool to get started: a reliable Shaker Bottle.
A shaker bottle with a built-in mixer element (like an ActionRod or ProBlend screen) makes it quick and easy to blend your powder smoothly with water or milk on the go—no blender or manual whisking required. For example, our NutraBio Perfect Shaker - 28 oz ($9.99) is leak-free, BPA-free, and dishwasher safe.
